text: ポケモンに　やさしく　すると　かならず　わかって　もらえるのよ

structure.jp: ポケモンに　やさしく　すると
かならず　わかって　もらえるのよ

patterns.name: 〜と (if/when)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever the first thing happens, the second always follows. やさしく　すると = 'if you are kind'.

patterns.name: 〜てもらう
patterns.span: わかって　もらえる
patterns.explanation: てもらう says someone does something for your benefit; もらえる is its 'can' form. わかって　もらえる = 'you can get them to understand you'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: の at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, here in a soft feminine way with よ. もらえるのよ = 'they will understand you, you see'.
